replacements.instruction: Keep the formal W/(W+L) definition once in Experimental Design, but do not repeat formula notation in captions or other reader-facing locations; make CI fail if it is repeated outside the canonical definition.
replacements.before: \caption{Cross-family judge robustness using \modelCross. Within each selected contrast, W/L/T counts are summed over benchmarks before computing $W/(W+L)$; all three contrasts favor our system, but 3 of 9 benchmark-level comparisons reverse relative to the primary judge and many outcomes are ties. Commit is the fraction of eligible pairs with a non-tied cross-family outcome; Agreement is the fraction whose order-consistent outcome matches the primary judge.}
replacements.after: \caption{Cross-family judge robustness using \modelCross. Within each selected contrast, wins, losses, and ties are summed over benchmarks before computing the win rate; all three contrasts favor our system, but 3 of 9 benchmark-level comparisons reverse relative to the primary judge and many outcomes are ties. Commit is the fraction of eligible pairs with a non-tied cross-family outcome; Agreement is the fraction whose order-consistent outcome matches the primary judge.}
